note_on_authorship: contract-checker is read-only (Read/Grep/Glob) and cannot write this file; the audit was performed by the agent and the record transcribed verbatim by the main session, with the REMEDIATED blocks added after the fixes were applied and the pipeline re-run.

findings.summary: extended_horizon.parquet (#13) had no CSV mirror; the manifest requires CSV mirrors for #1, #3-#13, #15. Only extended_horizon_summary.csv existed.
findings.remediation: analysis/phases.py now writes results/extended_horizon.csv alongside the parquet; the mirror is produced by the pipeline, not by hand.

findings.summary: decision_gate.parquet was wide (one row per region, c1_*..c8_* columns) rather than the manifest's literal long form 'condition, value, threshold, passed'. Substance (8 conditions x 220 regions) was present; shape differed.
findings.remediation: analysis/gate.py additionally emits results/decision_gate_conditions.parquet/.csv in the exact long form (region, axis, n_obs, n_unique_trades, condition, metric, value, threshold, operator, passed). The wide table is retained because the REPORT cites per-region context that the long form drops.

findings.summary: buckets.py::slices() skips a zero-row YEAR/SIDE slice, so an empty partition would have been dropped silently rather than surfaced. Moot in this run (all 10 partitions non-empty) but not structurally enforced.
findings.remediation: validate.py gains gate 'domain_completeness_partitions_and_offsets', which asserts the 10-cell year x side grid against an explicit expected set and asserts all 40 dense offsets are present with alive > 0. Completeness is now asserted, not inferred.

findings.summary: validation_report.json gate 'auditors_clean' read present:false for both auditors because it was written before the audits ran.
findings.remediation: validate.py re-run after both audit status files landed; the gate is now satisfied from the real files.

labels_reachable.C: DISCLOSED DEFECT — unreachable when the SPEC 8 gate closes, because 6 routes a closed gate only to D/E/F/G. Self-reported in REPORT.md section 11 item 4 and adjudicated with a placebo CONTROL rather than by amending the frozen SPEC after seeing results.
labels_reachable.D: reachable; its frozen condition was literally satisfied but was NOT routed to, because Phase 11 shows the quantity it rests on is non-causal. Reasoning stated in REPORT.md section 13.

seal_evidence: implementation/build.py asserts 2026 not in the population's years before any walk
validate.py gate no_2026_access confirms over both the trade panel and the observation panel
2025-not-threshold-OOS waiver disclosed in partition_manifest.json and REPORT.md section 14

c4_d_e.D_train_serve_determinism: PASS — single deterministic pipeline, seeded placebos (20260811), inherited engine reused unchanged; replay gate 0 mismatches over 8,671 observation states
